platform: Ubuntu 22.04 amd64 LP64, GCC 11.4, libc6-dev headers

assumptions: Zero initial sales, six requests and capacity five; all agents complete one reservation attempt.
semantics.initial_state: static C initialization; main is the sole entry
semantics.library_model: pthread and C library built into the pinned Deagle binary
semantics.preprocessor: GCC system preprocessor as invoked by the locked Deagle C front end
semantics.thread_bound: Exactly six agents, each makes one request; main creates all six and joins all six.
